note: Baseline misses energy-density threshold; thermal margin passes and plating is mechanically checked from anode potential.

recommendation: Not achieved within the tested design boundary and simulation budget. Chen2020 baseline and architecture variants remained below 500.94 Wh/kg and plated at 4C; OKane2022 SiOx escalation also remained below the energy threshold, exceeded 60C, and plated. Do not claim a passing design.
